'''Yindo''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed on the [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']]. During the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], he transported a Republic strike team to [[Kaon]].<ref name="TOR:OinTH" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yindo serves as the quest giver for the Republic version of the Flashpoint Kaon Under Siege in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
